referencePolicy: No new scene may show an identifiable recurring person or recognizable recurring group. This exhaustive placement inventory is a candidate index, not a claim that every person in a chapter is visible. See the existing full-size continuity audits for approved anchors and rejected candidates.

approvedAnchorGuidance.traitsRecordedInPriorAudit: Medium-brown complexion, natural dark curls, youthful slim build then adult beard and sturdier build; rebellion older with gray. Jonathan is the robe donor, not David. No universal sequential age is assigned to poetic superscriptions or Samuel appendices.
Older medium-brown man, tight gray curls, full white beard, weathered face and older build. Deuteronomy 3 is uncertain and excluded.
Mature face, gray-to-white beard, priest head covering, blue/white clothing. Numbers 16 and Miriam/Aaron Story have unresolved drift; do not use as new identity anchors.
